versions.changelog:
caesar-cipher-skill v0.1.0

- Initial release: Provides a Caesar cipher tool for encryption, decryption, and brute-force (fuzz) operations.
- Supports basic CLI and API usage with customizable shift (1–25) or full brute-force across all offsets.
- Handles only English letters; non-letter characters are preserved.
- Includes clear usage instructions and example commands.
